ai_summary: Aarti Surfactants Limited has successfully upgraded its long-term credit rating for Rs 200 crores of bank loan facilities from CARE BBB+; Stable to CRISIL A-/ Stable. This positive revision, following a transition to CRISIL Ratings Limited, indicates improved creditworthiness for the company, potentially leading to more favorable borrowing terms and enhanced investor confidence. No red flags are apparent in this credit rating announcement.
